attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, while the page itself puts his death on 18 Μαΐου 1985; the row records the day page that was read and the difference is the page's own. Nothing in the corpus answers to him. The page prints no hymn. He is the most recent saint on this day's listing by three and a half centuries.
